entities.summary: Jagbir Singh is a former Indian field hockey player who played as a centre-forward. He represented India in two Olympics, 1990 World Cup and was a leading light of the Indian team in all the major tournaments, for a decade, from 1985 to 1995, including two Asian Games, the 1989 Asia Cup & Champions trophy.
